北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，体感 6℃ 较凉。出行请注意安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels cool at 6℃. Please drive safely!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波中雨，体感 13℃ 湿凉。记得带伞，小心路滑。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has moderate rain, feels damp and cool at 13℃. Remember your umbrella, be careful on wet roads.
宁波.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨微凉，体感 13℃。带好雨具，别着凉了。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain and feels cool at 13℃. Take your umbrella, avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 27℃ 挺热。注意防潮，保持舒爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and feels warm at 27℃. Watch out for humidity, stay comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 27℃。风力 3级，穿衣清爽就好。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and feels warm at 27℃. With a level 3 breeze, light clothing is fine.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，体感 13℃ 湿冷。出门记得带伞添衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and feels damp and cold at 13℃. Remember your umbrella and extra clothes.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨，体感 11℃，风力 3级。注意保暖防湿！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain, feels like 11℃ with a level 3 wind. Stay warm and dry!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都天晴，体感 15℃。湿度高，仍要注意防潮哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is clear, feels like 15℃. High humidity, remember to prevent dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 11℃ 湿冷。风力 3级，多穿点哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels damp and cold at 11℃. With a level 3 wind, dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 8℃ 较冷。注意添衣，别着凉了。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels quite cold at 8℃. Remember to add layers, avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 15℃。注意防潮，保持舒适。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels like 15℃. Watch out for humidity, stay comfortable.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 2℃，风力 4级。注意防风保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, feels like 2℃ with a level 4 wind. Watch out for wind, stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 13℃，风力 5级。注意防风，多添衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast, feels like 13℃ with a level 5 wind. Watch out for wind, dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明天晴，体感 17℃ 舒适。享受阳光好心情！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear, feels comfortable at 17℃. Enjoy the sunshine!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 24℃。温和舒适，风力 3级。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is partly cloudy, feels like 24℃. Mild and comfortable, with a level 3 wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 17℃，风力 4级。注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast, feels like 17℃ with a level 4 wind. Watch out for wind, stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 13℃，风力 5级。注意防风，多添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is partly cloudy, feels like 13℃ with a level 5 wind. Watch out for wind, dress warmly.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云，体感 27℃ 较热。注意防晒补水哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is partly cloudy, feels warm at 27℃. Remember sun protection and hydration.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨绵绵，湿度高。出门别忘带伞，注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella, stay warm.
